discovery: Discovery of time-reversal-invariant topological insulators and the experimental realization of the quantum spin Hall and quantum anomalous Hall effects

nominees.name: Qi-Kun Xue
nominees.affiliation: Southern University of Science and Technology and Tsinghua University, China

motivation: Kane, with Mele, showed that spin-orbit coupling can give time-reversal-invariant insulators a Z2 topological order with protected helical edge and surface states, a new phase of matter distinct from the quantum Hall states recognized in 2016. Molenkamp gave the first experimental proof, observing quantized edge conduction of the quantum spin Hall effect in HgTe quantum wells (2007). Xue achieved the long-sought quantum anomalous Hall effect in magnetically doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 films (2013): quantized Hall resistance at zero magnetic field, realizing Haldane's 1988 vision in a real material through heroic molecular-beam-epitaxy control. Together these works established topological band theory as a predictive, experimentally verified framework. It launched the global search for topological materials, now catalogued across thousands of compounds, and underpins research on axion insulators, Majorana platforms, and dissipationless electronics. The theory-to-material-to-measurement chain here is a model of modern condensed matter physics.
